column3: “a dead person” renders “a soul (nefesh),” and “his people” renders “his kinsmen” (throughout the chapter).
“as a relative by marriage” renders “a husband (ba’al)”; the meaning is uncertain.
“the bread” renders “the food (lechem)” (also in verses 8, 17 and 21–22).
“a woman who is profaned by harlotry” renders two terms, “a harlot and a profaned woman” (also in verse 14).
“the highest” renders “the great (priest),” “consecrated” renders “whose hand has been filled,” and “uncover his head” renders “let his head loose.”
“any dead person” renders “any souls of the dead.”
“a disfigured face” and “any deformed limb” render two rare terms (harum, sarua) whose meaning is uncertain.
“a dwarf” renders “daq (thin)”; several terms in this verse are of uncertain meaning.
“the most holy” renders “the holy of holies.”
